ITEM 1 | Scrambled, pale-yellow egg mass with soft, fluffy curds and a few small darker-edged bits, spread in an irregular mound across the upper-left of the plate, about 12 cm across and 2 cm tall, moist-looking, no visible browning | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed watermelon, bright red flesh with pale edges, cut into roughly 2.5 cm cubes, glossy and juicy, scattered in a cluster at the upper-right of the plate next to the cantaloupe | 95
ITEM 3 | Cubed cantaloupe, orange-peach flesh with slightly irregular edges, cut into roughly 2 cm cubes, matte and moist, scattered on the right side of the plate below the watermelon | 105
ITEM 4 | Round, browned sausage-style pieces with a dark brown glossy crust and slight char marks, about 2.5 cm in diameter, six pieces clustered at the lower-center of the plate under and beside the eggs | 120
